author: smuzaffar
body:
This fixes the [build errors](https://cmssdt.cern.ch/SDT/cgi-bin/buildlogs/el9_amd64_gcc16/CMSSW_20_1_X_2026-09-17-2300/DataFormats/SoATemplate)  we get in GCC16 IBs 

```
In file included from input_line_7:36:
  [src/DataFormats/SoATemplate/test/FakeSoA.h:86](https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/blob/CMSSW_20_1_X_2026-09-17-2300/DataFormats/SoATemplate/test/FakeSoA.h#L86):3: error: unknown type name 'uint16_t'
   uint16_t *a16_ = nullptr;                      //[size_]
  ^
  [src/DataFormats/SoATemplate/test/FakeSoA.h:87](https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/blob/CMSSW_20_1_X_2026-09-17-2300/DataFormats/SoATemplate/test/FakeSoA.h#L87):3: error: unknown type name 'uint32_t'
   uint32_t *b32_ = nullptr;                      //[size_]
  ^
  [src/DataFormats/SoATemplate/test/FakeSoA.h:21](https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/blob/CMSSW_20_1_X_2026-09-17-2300/DataFormats/SoATemplate/test/FakeSoA.h#L21):32: error: use of undeclared identifier 'uint16_t'
     return nElements * (sizeof(uint16_t) + sizeof(uint32_t)) + padding_ + 0x400;
                               ^
  [src/DataFormats/SoATemplate/test/FakeSoA.h:21](https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/blob/CMSSW_20_1_X_2026-09-17-2300/DataFormats/SoATemplate/test/FakeSoA.h#L21):51: error: use of undeclared identifier 'uint32_t'
     return nElements * (sizeof(uint16_t) + sizeof(uint32_t)) + padding_ + 0x400;
                                                  ^
  [src/DataFormats/SoATemplate/test/FakeSoA.h:35](https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/blob/CMSSW_20_1_X_2026-09-17-2300/DataFormats/SoATemplate/test/FakeSoA.h#L35):38: error: use of undeclared identifier 'uint16_t'
     memcpy(a16_, onfile.a16_, sizeof(uint16_t) * onfile.size_);
                                     ^
  [src/DataFormats/SoATemplate/test/FakeSoA.h:36](https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/blob/CMSSW_20_1_X_2026-09-17-2300/DataFormats/SoATemplate/test/FakeSoA.h#L36):38: error: use of undeclared identifier 'uint32_t'
     memcpy(b32_, onfile.b32_, sizeof(uint32_t) * onfile.size_);
                                     ^
  [src/DataFormats/SoATemplate/test/FakeSoA.h:43](https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/blob/CMSSW_20_1_X_2026-09-17-2300/DataFormats/SoATemplate/test/FakeSoA.h#L43):65: error: unknown type name 'intptr_t'
               << reinterpret_cast<std::byte *>(reinterpret_cast<intptr_t>(b32_) - reinterpret_cast<intptr_t>(a16_))
                                                                ^
  [src/DataFormats/SoATemplate/test/FakeSoA.h:43](https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/blob/CMSSW_20_1_X_2026-09-17-2300/DataFormats/SoATemplate/test/FakeSoA.h#L43):100: error: unknown type name 'intptr_t'
               << reinterpret_cast<std::byte *>(reinterpret_cast<intptr_t>(b32_) - reinterpret_cast<intptr_t>(a16_))
                                                                                                   ^
  [src/DataFormats/SoATemplate/test/FakeSoA.h:64](https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/blob/CMSSW_20_1_X_2026-09-17-2300/DataFormats/SoATemplate/test/FakeSoA.h#L64):28: error: use of undeclared identifier 'uint32_t'
       if (b32_[i] != 24 + (uint32_t)i) {
                           ^
  [src/DataFormats/SoATemplate/test/FakeSoA.h:76](https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/blob/CMSSW_20_1_X_2026-09-17-2300/DataFormats/SoATemplate/test/FakeSoA.h#L76):29: error: unknown type name 'uint16_t'
     a16_ = reinterpret_cast<uint16_t *>(buffer);
                            ^
  [src/DataFormats/SoATemplate/test/FakeSoA.h:77](https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/blob/CMSSW_20_1_X_2026-09-17-2300/DataFormats/SoATemplate/test/FakeSoA.h#L77):34: error: use of undeclared identifier 'uint16_t'
     buffer += nElements * sizeof(uint16_t) + padding_;
                                 ^
  [src/DataFormats/SoATemplate/test/FakeSoA.h:78](https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/blob/CMSSW_20_1_X_2026-09-17-2300/DataFormats/SoATemplate/test/FakeSoA.h#L78):29: error: unknown type name 'uint32_t'
     b32_ = reinterpret_cast<uint32_t *>(buffer);
                            ^
  [src/DataFormats/SoATemplate/test/FakeSoA.h:79](https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/blob/CMSSW_20_1_X_2026-09-17-2300/DataFormats/SoATemplate/test/FakeSoA.h#L79):34: error: use of undeclared identifier 'uint32_t'
     buffer += nElements * sizeof(uint32_t);
```
title: [GCC16] Added missing cstdint for uint16_t/uint32_t
